description: Land Title Settlement Department - Lunuwila, Wennapuwa D/S Division, Puttalam District - Cad. Map No. 410001
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content is published in "PART III - LANDS" and focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, making it a clear example of a Land Gazette.
